items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Javon Jackson and you and other people in that generation, it’s just harder to keep a group performing.

ctx.x: So why is it — I guess it’s an obvious thing here, why can’t that happen now? Javon Jackson and you and other people in that generation, it’s just harder to keep a group performing.

Part of it is there’s not enough places to play, there again. Nowadays when I look at trying to book gigs and book tours — and it’s not just me, this is from talking with other guys — there was a time where you could go out and say okay, well I’m going to play this place for a week, I know I’m here Tuesday through Sunday. If I get lucky maybe I can find something on the Monday. You know what I mean? And in most of the cities you’d go and play that jazz venue for a week. Now, a lot of times if these cities have…
